featured_reviews.name: Vaspar Dandiwala
featured_reviews.review_text:
How do you know the right Mover & Packer for you?

When you have to move from your home of 52 years the core value you would look for in a Mover & Packer is trust.

I wasn't going to allow my old furniture to be scratched or who knows, in the chaos, something getting lost or flicked. I knew that the Agarwals were expensive, but didn't even know which one of the 3 online was the OG.

I had taken Savio's number from a lady whose home I was looking to rent after she vacates. She seemed very nice, but not the stamp of approval I needed. Until I read their Google Reviews. I found couple of my friends who were satisfied customers, even verified with one of them and immediately booked Homepack.in. His men supervised by Christopher were thorough, organised, friendly and efficient - not a scratch. Slightly on the expensive side, but felt worth it.

I'm writing this review in case a friend of mine considers Homepack.in. They should feel assured that their furniture is in good hands.
